review_evidence: README identifies C-CoRN as a constructive formalization of algebraic structures, real and complex numbers, the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra, real calculus and exact real computation.

All 375 primary formal files were inventoried: 363 own common Coq declaration forms, totaling about 10,951 declarations. Representative retained modules include algebra/CPolynomials.v, logic/CLogic.v, fta/FTA.v and ftc/Taylor.v.

The declaration-light files are scope/tactic/representation modules embedded in the formal library; inspection did not establish a lossless exact selector separating mere tooling from reusable proof interfaces, so they remain searchable.
summary: Retain the complete primary C-CoRN formal library; no source-local hard exclusion was proven lossless.
